title: Power is not energy: why the difference matters
summary: Technology Connections explains the difference between power (watts) and energy (watt-hours) and why confusing them leads to errors. It runs about 52 minutes and uses everyday examples.
why: HN points to it whenever a thread mixes up power and energy, such as battery specs and solar generation.

quote.text: Technology Connections made a pretty good 52 minute video about it the other month
